title: Letterpress Printing — An idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: Type is pressed
scenes.purpose: State the premise as two lines of type pressed into cool ash-grey cotton stock, with the frame rules and caption already printed.
visuals: WebGL2 paper field: cotton fibres, felt tooth, sparse inclusions, soft raking light from the left
Pre-printed double rule frame (dark plus oxblood) and bottom caption
Kicker and two headline lines, each pressed by its own platen contact

beats.development: Kicker 'NO. 52 · A STUDY IN IMPRESSION' (oxblood) and 'An idea becomes' press in: ink transfers in about 0.2s while the shallow impression bites a little past rest and springs back.
'a connected system' presses on its own cue; both lines are then fully inked and stay settled from about 0.9s.

scenes.title: The idea and its field
scenes.purpose: Introduce the idea as a single oxblood node set in a blind-debossed round field.
visuals: Blind (uninked) circular impression, r=162px, compressed floor reads slightly darker
Oxblood centre node pressed with ink

beats.development: Blind deboss forms the round field, then the oxblood idea node is pressed into its centre.

scenes.title: The system connects
scenes.purpose: Show the idea becoming a connected system: spokes, nodes, then the perimeter link that closes the network.
visuals: Six spokes ink outward from the idea node (radial reach gate)
Six outer node rings pressed when the spokes arrive
Perimeter links sweep clockwise and close the hexagon

beats.development: Spokes ink and impress outward from the centre to the six node positions.
Node rings press (from 1.84s) and the perimeter connections sweep clockwise until the network closes at about 2.46s.
Everything is still: the finished card is held so the full composition reads.
captions: PRESSED BY HAND · TWO INKS · COTTON STOCK

findings: Headline readable from about 0.9s and stays still for the rest of the clip.
Each development has its own cue: type, field, idea, spokes, nodes, perimeter.
Paper, lighting and pre-printed rules stay still; only foreground impressions and ink change.
justifiedHolds: 2.5–3.0s: settled hold so the whole card can be read.

notes: Silent preview: no music, effects or voice.

No preview_recipes were supplied in STYLE.json; the preview shows the core implementation (glyph/graphic-outline impressions with separate paper, ink-coverage, impression-depth and soft-light controls).

BACKGROUND_REVIEW.json found no matched sources and lists no contact sheets, so no source observations are claimed. The cool ash-grey cotton stock (#DFE3DF) is a scene-dependent choice replacing the earlier cream swatch.
The impressions are a procedural height-field approximation, not a physical paper simulation.
